steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Musical theatre combines drama, music and dance — songs advance the plot and reveal character, not just provide entertainment. | Key Fact: Leitmotifs (recurring musical themes) represent characters, places or ideas — used extensively in musicals to create associations. | Key Fact: Broadway orchestration combines classical instruments with rhythm section and amplification — the pit orchestra balances with sung text. | Key Fact: Singing styles: belt (powerful chest voice for emotional climaxes), legit (classical head voice for lyrical moments), mix (blend of both for versatility).
